interface_detail: two documented Base URLs: https://api.stepfun.ai/step_plan for the Claude Code and Anthropic SDK shape, and https://api.stepfun.ai/step_plan/v1 for OpenAI SDK Chat Completions. The page states these are client configuration URLs and not full request URLs
